title: Boxer Portrait Study
description: A black and white pencil sketch of a young male boxer in fighting stance occupies the center of the image. He wears gloves, a tight tank top, and shorts, with a shaved head and an intense facial expression. The drawing is placed over layered translucent sheets featuring large reversed black text reading 'STASIS' and 'SAM' against a vibrant hot pink background.
prompt: A realistic pencil sketch of a young male boxer with a shaved head, wearing boxing gloves, tank top and shorts, captured mid-fight in a low athletic stance with fists raised and focused expression. The drawing is centered on white paper, overlaid on translucent layers with large bold black text spelling STASIS and SAM reversed, all set against a solid bright hot pink background.
